pr_body:
# W3CLogger follow-ups

Clean up tasks for the W3CLogger middleware

## Description

- Updates `W3CLogger.cs` to resolve `W3CLoggerProcessor` from DI
- Adds a helper method for converting status codes to strings (to avoid calling `int.ToString`)
- Adds helper methods for finding log file names and paths in `FileLoggerProcessorTests`
- Cleans up some variables in `FileLoggerProcessorTests` that were named like "fileName" but are actually file paths

Fixes #33945
pr_comments: Thanks for your PR, @david-acker. Someone from the team will get assigned to your PR shortly and we'll get it reviewed.

@wtgodbe I produced logs with the `Logging.W3C.Sample` project before and after these changes and verified that the log paths remained the same for the three cases (default, relative path, absolute path). I also checked the contents of the log files themselves while I was at it--just to be safe.
